and played all over this nation before finally returning to Green Bay as assistant to

Red was born in Combined Locks, Wis... he played one year of varsity football at
Lawrence college in Appleton, and had two big years at guard for Notre Dame ...
played with the championship Packers of 1929... was a New York Yankee in 1928,
and a Packer the year before that ... in 1930 and 1931 the New York Giants had
him in tow ... this is his fourth season as Packer assistant coach ... other coaching
included Seton Hall College, Georgetown University and the University of Wisconsin
... married ... lives in Milwaukee and Green Bay.

BECKER is a home town boy who made good ...
started pro ball with the Chicago Bears in 1934 ...
then went to the Brooklyn Dodgers... landed with
the Packers via trade ... now in his fourth season
here ... excellent punter . . . born in Green Bay ...
played at East high school and Marquette University
28 years old. .. plays either end of the line.
SCHULTZ, a Minnesota product, is one of the most
promising first year tackles on the squad ... terrific
charger . . . played some guard in college, but was
settled at tackle by his senior year . .. weighs 230
... 6 feet 2½ . . . 24 years old . . out of school in
1934 because of injuries, but hasn't been seriously
hurt since . . . letterman in track . .. home in St.
SVENDSEN played with the Packers in 1937, then
left for a year of coaching . . . returned this season
... second of the Minnesota Svendsens to play with
Green Bay . . . his brother George, also a center,
came first ... few people know his first name is Barl
•.. everyone calls him Bud. .. half inch over 6 feet
one son . .. home in Minneapolis... Phi Gamma

field goal kickers... despite his 230 pounds, people
eighth year . .. started with the Bears after three
varsity years at Northwestern . . . came to Green
Bay via Brooklyn midway in 1934... developed into
one of the team's steadiest guards ... 6 feet 1 ...
married ... born in Chariton, Iowa, but now makes
his home in Green Bay ... 29 years old.

McGROARTY started out as a freshman football
prospect at Marquette University, but he wound up
at little Northland College in Ashland, Wis.
starred for three years where he was one of only two
men on the squad who weighed over 200 pounds...
his weight is 205 . .. 6 feet 2 ... 21 years old ...
single... home in Milwaukee, Wis. . . first attempt
to crash the big league.. . punts, passes and runs.
GANTENBEIN is captain of the Packers . .. for
eight years he played right end, but this season was
shifted over to left... he handles either side well
former University of Wisconsin captain ... splendid
leader . .. comes from LaCrosse, Wis. .. but like
other Packers now lives here ... fraction over 6 feet
tall ... 197 pounds... married ... one son, Tad ...
member of Sigma Chi fraternity ... 29 years old.
LETLOW, picked at left guard, was one of three
Packer choices on the National league honor team

should be as great..."found" by Curly Lambeau in

GREENFIELD is one of two Packer centers from the
University of Arizona ... home in Glendale, Ariz..•
Tom is 21 and the youngest Packer . . . six-letter
man in college... three in football and three in
basketball ... center in both sports ... first year here
toward government work in animal husbandary ...
PURUCKER is a 10-second dash man who also
kicks and passes . . . home in Youngstown, Ohio,
but he attended the University of Michigan . ..
varsity track and football . . . standout in games
against Yale and Minnesota in 1938 . .. 5 feet 11 ...
21 years old . . . single.. . Sigma Nu . .. qualified

GOLDENBERG, known in the trade and to fans as
Buckets, has played fullback, quarterback and guard
in seven Packer seasons... now he is permanently
situated at the latter position ... built like an army
tank ... 5 feet 10 . .. 215 pounds... born in Odessa,
Russia ... raised in Milwaukee . .. schooled at the
University of Wisconsin... now in the insurance
and loan business in Green Bay ... 28 years old ...
BUHLER is one of a long line of great Minnesota
fullbacks... this is his first year in the pro game...
one of the Big Ten's best backs in 1938 .. . Chieago
6 feet 2 .. . native of Windom, Minn.. . single ...
an auto aceident nearly put him out of football last
winter .. . but he recovered with no ill effects . . .
fast, he also can play halfback.
BRUDER is a veteran who outraces time ... at 32
he is the oldest Packer player ... came to Green Bay
from Northwestern University . .. has played every
backfield position, but now is set at the blocking
post... another punter . .. native of Pekin, III...
operates a tire shop in Green Bay ... 200 pounds...
6 feet tall ... married and the father of a son . .
RAY appears destined to become one of the truly
great tackles of professional football ... three varsity
years at Vanderbilt where he weighed 280 . .
trained down to 245 for his second Packer season ...
co-captain of his college team ... 6 feet 6 ... prefers
the campus-given nickname "Baby" to his real tag
...24 years old ... not married ... born in Antioch,
KELL is the only Notre Dame player on the Packer
roster now, despite the fact that both Coach Curly
Lambeau and Assistant played with the Irish . . .
plays the right side of the line .. home in Indiana
... 22 years old . .. single . .. playing his first year
of post-graduate football . . . probably will enter
ZOLL learned his football right in Green Bay ...
born here, he played at West high school . . . three
Cleveland Rams, one of which he played at guard in
a makeshift lineup ... 25 years old ... 223 pounds
... 6 feet 1 ... recently married a girl from Cleveland
... spends summers handling rocks in his father's
SCHNEIDMAN is one of the least publicized and
most valuable players on the Packer team .. . even
in high school at Quiney, IIl., he played blocking
back ... fine defensive player... filled in at end for
the Packers one season... wearing the Green Bay
colors for the fifth year... Iowa is his alma mater
... one of the quietest men on the squad ... and
one of the headiest... 5 feet 10. .. 205 pounds...

BROCK was selected as starting center in the
Chicago All-Star fans' balloting. .. had three great
years at Nebraska... many honor team citations..
in his first Packer year he helps plug Green Bay's
most vulnerable spot of the 1938 season ... big, but
fleet .. . 6 feet 1, with 193 pounds around it . . . 22
years old . .. married . .. home in Lincoln, Neb...
labored on pipelines during the summer.
JANKOWSKI was one of Wisconsin's greatest backs
of the past decade ... suffered an injury at the close
of the 1937 season that handicapped him last year,
but is completely recovered now ... plays relief for
Hinkle and has wound up in the star's role himself
... only 5 feet 9... keeps down to an even 200 ...
home in Milwaukee where he was given an auto-
mobile on "Jankowski Day" last season .. . single

yearling ... at Minnesota he played both guard and
tackle on both sides of the line... with Green Bay

HINKLE was selected as all-league fullback for the
past three seasons... he was the team's high scorer
last year with 58 points... everything a back should
be, line bucker, long runner, passer, punter, place-
kicker, blocker and defensive great... eighth season
with the Packers . . . undergraduate football at

GREEN BAY - Legion Building, 319 East Walnut Street
Lambeau is the father of the Packers as well as coach ... a native of Green Bay,
he was one of its greatest fullbacks . . . this is his 21st year of service in Packer
ranks... he started the team as a packing company booster aggregation in 1919 ...
his hair has given him the name Curly.
Curly played until 1928. .. listed on his record are 109 points on 12 touchdowns
and 19 extra points... and six field goals... one of the game's greatest exponents
of the forward pass, he was an aerial expert as a player ... anthor of texts on how
to pass... coached such great passers as Arnold Herber ... Bob Monnett and Cecil
Lambeau's years in the game add up to the longest service record in the National
Professional league... coached league title winners in 1929, 1930, 1931, and 1936 ...
western division champions in 1938... known from coast to coast, he scouts his own
material ... played under the late Knute Rockne at Notre Dame .. • teammate of
the famous George Gipp ... active in the insurance business when football doesn't
devote all his time ... which no longer is often.

... a rugged end who loves the game, he probably
will make the grade in his first National Professional

University . • • made an impressive debut at right
tackle last year ... 240 ponuds ... 6 feet 3 ... calls
Shenandoah, Pa., home ... just 22, Katalinas is the
youngest tackle on the squad . . . eastern inter-
up for practice this year with a beard
his age . .. ticketed for a great year .
JOHNSTON, pound for pound, is one of the hardest
men in the game ... 5 feet 10 and 195 pounds, but
looks smaller . . . former fullback. . . moved to
blocking back in 1937 . . . and to guard late last
season . .. became football famous with the St. Louis
college all claim him ... born in Appleton, Wis. .•
STEEN is an all-around athlete who at present is
making a career of two of his sports . .. for the past
two summers played baseball . . . this season, one
year out of college, signed with the Packers . .. an
outstanding offensive end, he also fills his defensive
assignments well . . . at Rice Institute he played

out of the early season play by a shoulder injury
sustained in practice with the Chicago All-Stars ...
strong player with a comparatively weak University
of Iowa football team ... former Lane Tech, Chicago,
prep star ... home in Chicago ... 21 years old ...
single ... first Packer year ... at 215 pounds, and
is the older brother of End Carl Mulleneaux... has
had several years' experience in the league .

general ... left handed passer ... also kicks from

punts ... most valuable in the Big 10 as an lowa

one year after graduation from Utah State, but one
season proved he was well worth waiting for ... this
is his second... plays the right flank . .. 210 pounds
... 6 feet 3½ •.. fast ... 23 years old ... tried the
grocery business in California, but came to Green
Bay to work last summer ... born in Phoenix, Ariz.

225 pounds... 29 years old ... married ... one son

ache and pain expert ... shares top honors with the
Chicago Bears Andy Lotshaw as a trainer ... takes
a personal interest in the condition of each boy ...
had a dozen years at the University of Minnesota be-

BIOLO comes to Green Bay from Michigan's upper-
peninsula, a Packer fans' stronghold ... his home
is in Iron Mountain . • gained wide recognition as
an outstanding guard at Lake Forest college . . .
coached and praised by Ralph Jones, former Chieago
Bears coach .. . also played baseball in college ...
HERBER is one of the National Professional league's
greatest passers.• produet of Green Bay West High
and Regis college . .. captained the University of
Wisconsin freshman in between . .. 29 years old ...
started with the Packers when he was 20 . . . one of
the signal callers... also punts... 5 feet 11
men's clothing store in DePere, Wis. .. Delta Sigma
WEISGERBER came to the Packers in 1938 as a
fullback, but was shifted to right half in the Lambeau
system . .. starred at Williamette University where
he was captian in his last two years . . . born and
raised in East Orange, N. J., but spends most of his
time in Oregon near the site of his alma mater ...
WILSON is the smallest Packer freshman . .. he is
5 feet 8 inches tall and weighs 160 . . . spent two
years at the University of Wisconsin and two at
at Dubuque led the Iowa college conference in scor-
ing . . . highly recommended despite his small
stature ... excellent punter and passer ... home in
Richland Center, Wis. .. 24 years old . .. single ...
LOCK is getting his second chance at a permanent
Packer berth after being forced to retire last season
because of injuries sustained as a member of the
Eastern All-Stars . . . comes from Fordham where
Packer alumnus Jimmy Crowley is coach ... home
in Plains, Pa. .. 25 years old ... 5 feet 9½. .. 205
pounds.. known as the "Bull" at Fordham because
of his vicious charging . .. worked as government
TINSLEY is another Packer from the South . . .
played almost every position on his college team at
Georgia... placed at guard after a start at blocking
back with the Packers... second year here ... stand-
ing but 5 feet 8, his 205 pounds is more felt than
seen ... ealls Spartenberg, South Carolina, home...
26 years old . .. single ... a southerner who likes
the north, he may settle here.
NOVAKOFSKI is making his first attempt to gain
a Packer berth as a pony back . .. 5 feet 9½... 170
pounds . . five letterman at Lawrence College...
three in football ... one each in basketball and track
picked as "most valuable"... hopes to coach eventu-
home in Menasha, Wis. . . member of Phi
HUTSON has twice been selected as all-league end
... in 1936 and 1938. .. one of the game's greatest
forward pass receivers, he has made 33 touchdowns
in four seasons with the Packers. . . also made four
extra points.. one of the fastest men on the squad
...engaged in business in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, in
URAM is one of six Minnesota boys who started
the season with the Packers . .. three great years
with the Gophers with whom he averaged between
7 and 8 yards per play... started with Isbell in the
Chicago All-Star backfield of 1938 ... second Packer
... either right or left half, but set at the
years old ... married ... home in Minneapolis.
CRAIG was sent to the Packers by his South Caro-
lina coach, Rex Enright, a former Bay fullback ...
speedy and powerful, he promises to become one of
the league's great defensive flankmen . .. first year
out of school . .. varsity basketball and track. ..
205 pounds. .. 6 feet tall ... 23 years old ... home
in Central, South Carolina ... has been tried success-
fully at blocking back ... Blue Key honorary fra-

College All-Star team in Chicago ... a capable pass
receiving end, he is a constant threat ... selected by
his teammates as most valuable at Fordham Univer-
sity last season . .. highly recommended by Jimmy
Crowley, his coach ... home in New Briton, Conn.,
but spends much of his time in New York City ...
